title: Pregnant Blend 4-Mix Duo #11 (동심원·물결 / 가로 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Filipina, in her early 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real pores, real living eyes, 15 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with amethysts in bronze-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of platinum earrings. Painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 27%, 42% and 77% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with floral medallion border filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with overglaze florals filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, with concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her late 40s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, sleek silver-grey hair styled in elegant updo, real pores, real living eyes, 8 drop dangles piercings set with pearls in brass-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a hair ornament. Painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 21% of the way down her figure from the top, about 42% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following the contours of the body, with repeating floral border filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star inlay filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with folk-art florals filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
